Fraction pLC 0,7
Maximum capacity (Emax) 1000 kg up to and including 5000 kg
Humidity Class CH
Temperature range -10 °C / +40 °C
Accuracy Class C
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n) 3000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval
Y = Emax / Vmin		 6000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return
Z = Emax / (2 * DR)		 3000
The characteristics for nmax and Y can be reduced separately. Z is proportional or equal to nmax. Each produced load cell is supplied with information about its characteristics.
